reason.tainted: Contains something that must not be touched: a database, git repository, credential, mount point, cloud placeholder or immutable file.
reason.domain_off: This area is turned off in settings.
reason.no_gain: Hard-linked file: removing this path frees no space.
reason.unsupported_action: No cleanup action is available for this item.

skip.changed: Changed since the plan was made
skip.unsafe_parent: A parent folder is a symlink or belongs to someone else

skip.too_recent: Newer than the age threshold now
skip.dataless: Cloud placeholder that is not downloaded
skip.unsupported_member: Holds something that cannot be archived: {detail}
